# Check what get_name produces for special chars
import sys
for mod in list(sys.modules.keys()):
    if 'markdown' in mod:
        del sys.modules[mod]

import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import get_name, stashedHTML2text

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc'])
text = '# Foo > & bar'
result = md.convert(text)
print(f"Result: {result}")

for el in md.parser.root.iter():
    if el.tag == 'h1':
        print(f"h1.text: {repr(el.text)}")
        name = get_name(el)
        print(f"get_name: {repr(name)}")
        
        # What does stashedHTML2text do?
        processed = stashedHTML2text(el.text, md, strip_entities=False)
        print(f"stashedHTML2text: {repr(processed)}")
        break
